message.content:
You are building the Settings page for a Shopify app called QuizSnap. Write the file at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.settings.tsx`.

This is a Shopify embedded app using React Router v7 and @shopify/polaris React components.

The Settings page has 4 sub-sections accessible via tabs. Use Polaris `Tabs` component.

## Tab 1: General Settings
- **Default quiz language**: Select dropdown (English, French, Spanish, German, Hindi)
- **Show 'Powered by QuizSnap' branding**: Toggle (default ON). Note: requires Starter plan
- **Revenue attribution window**: Select dropdown (3 days, 7 days recommended, 14 days, 30 days)  
- **Customer tag prefix**: TextField (default "qs-"). Shows example: prefix 'qs-' produces tag 'qs-skin-type:oily'
- Save button at bottom

## Tab 2: Email Capture
- **Collect emails before showing results**: Toggle (default ON)
- **Email screen headline**: TextField (default "Almost there! Get your personalised results")
- **GDPR consent text**: TextField (default "I agree to receive personalised recommendations by email.")
- **Skip link text**: TextField (default "Skip — show results anyway")
- **Discount reveal on email capture**: TextField (empty = disabled). Hint: "Enter a discount code like WELCOME10 to reveal after email capture"
- Save button at bottom

## Tab 3: Integrations
Show 4 integration cards using Polaris `Card`, `InlineStack`, `Badge`:

| Integration | Status | Description |
|------------|--------|-------------|
| Klaviyo | Connected (green badge) | Sends quiz events, answer data, email captures to Klaviyo |
| Omnisend | Not connected | Posts quiz completion events for SMS/email automations |
| Shopify Flow | Not connected | Creates native 'Quiz Completed' trigger |
| Webhooks | Not connected | Sends data to any external URL via HTTP POST |

Each card: icon/name on left, status badge, description, and Connect/Configure/Disconnect buttons.

## Tab 4: Plans & Billing
Show 3 plan cards side by side using Polaris `Layout.Section`:

| Plan | Price | Completions | Features |
|------|-------|-------------|----------|
| Free | $0/mo | 100/month | 1 quiz, all question types, basic analytics, branding shown |
| Starter (Most Popular) | $29/mo | Unlimited | 5 quizzes, Klaviyo + Webhooks, remove branding, advanced analytics, email capture |
| Pro | $79/mo | Unlimited | Unlimited quizzes, AI auto-mapping, A/B testing, Shopify Flow, priority support |

Starter card should have a "Most popular" badge. Current plan should show "Current plan" badge.

## Technical Requirements:
- Use loader with `authenticate.admin(request)` 
- Use state management with useState for form fields and selected tab
- Use `useAppBridge` for toast notifications on save
- Use Polaris components: Page, Layout, Card, Tabs, FormLayout, TextField, Select, Checkbox (for toggle use Checkbox), Button, Badge, Banner, Text, BlockStack, InlineStack, Divider
- Include mock data/defaults
- Save button shows toast "Settings saved" (use shopify.toast.show)
- Export headers using boundary.headers

The errors are just project-level config issues (JSX flag, module resolution) -- the same errors would apply to the existing `app.tsx` and `app._index.tsx` files. These are resolved by the Vite bundler at build time. The file itself is structurally correct.

The file has been created at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/QuizSnap/app/routes/app.settings.tsx`. Here is what it includes:

**Structure:**
- `loader` function calling `authenticate.admin(request)` and returning mock `currentPlan: "free"`
- `headers` export using `boundary.headers` 
- 4 tabs via Polaris `Tabs`: General Settings, Email Capture, Integrations, Plans & Billing

**Tab 1 - General Settings:**
- Language `Select` (English/French/Spanish/German/Hindi)
- Branding `Checkbox` (default ON, with "Requires Starter plan" help text)
- Attribution window `Select` (3/7 recommended/14/30 days)
- Tag prefix `TextField` (default "qs-") with dynamic example in help text
- Save button

**Tab 2 - Email Capture:**
- Collect emails `Checkbox` (default ON)
- Email headline, GDPR consent text, skip link text `TextField`s with specified defaults
- Discount code `TextField` (empty = disabled) with hint
- Save button

**Tab 3 - Integrations:**
- 4 cards (Klaviyo connected with green badge, Omnisend/Shopify Flow/Webhooks not connected)
- Connected integrations show Configure + Disconnect buttons; others show Connect button

**Tab 4 - Plans & Billing:**
- 3 plan cards in `oneThird` layout sections (Free/Starter/Pro)
- Starter has "Most popular" badge, current plan gets "Current plan" badge
- Upgrade/Downgrade buttons based on context

**Save behavior:** Calls `shopify.toast.show("Settings saved")` via `useAppBridge`.
